_doc: Locke's lines, keyed by room id then trigger. 'default' covers every room. Fields: text (shown beside Locke), glyph (input action whose button is shown small beside it; omit for none), clip (optional URL of a recorded line, e.g. /audio/vo/tut-a-move.ogg), hum (placeholder vocal when no clip: hum | grunt | chuckle | tsk). Triggers: entry (casing, once per attempt), nearMiss, alarm, clean (lift with no alarms), getaway, contact, plus room moments (feather, feather-back, statue-see, letgo, yank, land, overshoot, peel, reflection). taunt (teaches the taunt once the prize is in hand), taunt-say (said while puffing), orbit, move, stretch, flatten, sidle, place, rotate, crouch, lift, contact, fumble, rewind, escape.

orbit.text: Case the joint first. Clock's not running.

stretch.text: Why walk when you can reach?

flatten.text: Sideways. Like a card up a sleeve.

place.text: Mirror, mirror… show me the off switch.

rotate.text: A touch this way… or that.

contact.text: Ah. That one had my number.

fumble.text: Let's take that again, from the top.

taunt.text: Job's done. Time for a smoke.

entry.text: Evening. Let's not keep the treasure waiting.

clean.text: Not a whisker out of place.

stretch.text: Too narrow for the suit. Not for the arm.

flatten.text: Sideways. Like a card up a sleeve.

place.text: Mirror, mirror… show me the off switch.

entry.text: A diamond needs no guard but the dark. Then again, I like the dark.

clean.text: The Hope of Midnight. Hope rewarded.

contact.text: Clumsy. The diamond's embarrassed for me.

entry.text: Midnight on Fifth Avenue. Hat first.

move.text: Mind the gap: nine metres of it.

nearMiss.text: The beams are slow. I'm slower. On purpose.

letgo.text: Arm's done. A foot to go. …Fine.

getaway.text: In like a cat burglar. Which I am.

entry.text: Keep time, or be kept. A conductor with a sense of humour.

clean.text: And a one, and a two, and a sapphire.

getaway.text: Faster now. The band's warmed up.

lift.text: Tempo's going up. So am I: out.

entry.text: Madame Verre. Every mirror a little liar.

reflection.text: Nine feet tall. I'd always suspected.

alarm.text: Caught in my own reflection. Typical.

contact.text: Which one of me did that?

place.text: Bend it round the corner. Then up a notch.

entry.text: The Grand Staircase. Descend like you own it.

land.text: Stair rod. Two steps. Perfect posture.

entry.text: No one crosses Sir Ambrose's floor. I'll take the balcony.

nearMiss.text: Sir Ambrose is watching. Of course he is.

alarm.text: The floor's awake. Mind the plates.

lift.text: The whole floor just went live. Upstairs, then.

getaway.text: Good evening, Sir Ambrose. Do keep an eye on things.

contact.text: Stepped on his floor. He'll write a letter.

entry.text: Security should be beautiful. It is. So am I.

statue-see.text: Hang on. That statue's wearing my feather.

feather-back.text: I'll take that back, thank you.

clean.text: A ruby, from a marble hand. She didn't object.

lift.text: The sweeper's split in two. Rude.

entry.text: Every curator's fear, under one dome. Let's not disappoint them.

place.text: Half up here, half down the grate. Both locks at once.

alarm.text: The whole dome's lit. Lovely, really.

clean.text: The Crown. And not a whisker out of place.

lift.text: Every constellation at once. The door's sealed. Up it is.

entry.text: Up the ribs and out the skylight.

rotate.text: Bend the beam away. Then climb.
